caption: The drawing depicts a single pottery vessel with a rounded body, a narrow neck, and a small, outward-flaring mouth. The vessel is predominantly reddish-brown in color, displaying subtle tonal variations across its surface, including areas of lighter and darker shading that suggest a three-dimensional form. There is a rounded handle attached from the upper shoulder to just below the neck, which is also finished in the same reddish-brown color. Near the upper portion of the vessel, just below the neck, there are two horizontal bands, one of which is decorated with a wavy line pattern. The vessel’s body features a slightly reflective spot indicating a light source, and there are a few darker speckles and an irregular, small gray patch near the lower left side. The background is an off-white or beige color, plain and unadorned. The artist's signature "White" appears near the bottom of the vessel.
title: Economy Redware Jug
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
